messages:
alex_chang: Heads-up — I'm prototyping a Grafana dashboard to visualize tenant affinity across racks/regions, overlay SLO annotations, and surface networking egress hotspots. Want quick feedback before I add 15+ panels.

maria_gonzalez: Nice, affinity view could help explain some eviction patterns. Do you mean a heatmap by tenant x rack? :thinking_face: 

alex_chang: Exactly — tenant x rack heatmap (percent of GPU time / slot occupancy) + a per-tenant SLO burn-rate sparkline. Also want an annotation lane for deploys, canaries, and known network incidents.

priya_shah: Love the SLO overlay idea. Can we annotate automatic fallback events (model fallback to CPU) too? Those explain sudden latency spikes.

samir_k: +1. Also include a panel for cross-tenant network egress (packets/sec, retransmits) — we've seen noisy tenants correlated with network-induced throttling.

juniper: Small request: add cost per-GPU-hour estimate toggle. Ops wants to see short-term cost impact when we change placement affinity. Could be a derived series: cost = gpu_hour_rate * active_slots.

alex_chang: Good call. I'll add a collapsible cost overlay. Draft PromQL for affinity heatmap: 
```
sum by (tenant, rack) (increase(gpu_alloc_seconds_total[1h]))
/ on(tenant) group_left
sum by (tenant) (increase(gpu_alloc_seconds_total[1h]))
```
This yields % of time per rack for each tenant. Thoughts?

priya_shah: That looks right. For per-tenant SLO burn rate: 
```
sum by (tenant) (rate(slo_error_tokens_total[5m]))
/ sum by (tenant) (rate(slo_tokens_total[5m]))
```
We should smooth with a 5m avg and show 90/95 percentiles.

maria_gonzalez: For annotations, can we wire in our incident service and deploy-bot? Ideally a vertical band with title (deploy-id / incident-id). We already emit prometheus metrics like `deploys_total{env,team}` and `incident_events_total{id}`.

samir_k: Also add network QoS markers: packet drops > 0.1% and tx_retransmits spikes. Suggest an alert rule candidate: 
```
expr: increase(net_tx_retransmits_total[5m]) / increase(net_tx_packets_total[5m]) > 0.001
for: 10m
labels: {severity: warning, team: network}
```
We can reference that from the dashboard.

oncall-bot: Reminder: new dashboard should respect RBAC. eng and infra read, finance sees cost overlay only if allowed.

juniper: UX idea — make tenant rows collapsible and allow search by tenant prefix. We often want to zoom into a single tenant.

alex_chang: Solid. Implementation plan: 1) Create datasource panels (heatmap + table + per-tenant sparklines). 2) Annotation pipeline: subscribe to deploys/incident metrics -> grafana annotations. 3) Cost overlay computed via a templated variable (region rates). 4) Add link to allocation logs with prefilled query for selected tenant.

priya_shah: Can you stub the dashboard JSON and share? I can test queries against our dev Prometheus.

alex_chang: Will do. Minimal panel JSON snippet I'll use as a seed: 
```
{
  "type": "heatmap",
  "title": "Tenant x Rack Affinity",
  "targets": [ { "expr": "sum by (tenant, rack) (increase(gpu_alloc_seconds_total[1h]))" } ],
  "transform": "percent_of_row",
}
```
Not final, just to show structure.

maria_gonzalez: Ping me when it's up. If we can correlate with eviction logs and network drops, ops can do targeted throttles.

samir_k: One more — include a derived 'placement-bias' metric: difference between expected (fair-share) and observed allocation per tenant. Might help detect mis-scheduling.

alex_chang: Good idea — compute expected by `capacity * tenant_share` then show `observed - expected`. I'll add that.

juniper: Thanks Alex. If you want, I can mock a quick dashboard in a temp folder and we iterate.

alex_chang: Please do. I'll push a draft JSON to grafana/dev and share the link here. Targeting a canary release of the dashboard next Tue. :rocket: 

oncall-bot: Note: scheduling migration next Mon may change rack labels. Dashboard should support label aliasing (rack_id vs rack_name).

alex_chang: Good catch. I'll add templated label mapping. Thanks all for feedback — will post the draft soon.
